title: สร้างบอทเทรดคริปโตด้วย Claude AI — รอดวิกฤต BTC ร่วง -78% ปี 2022 ที่ Drawdown แค่ -14.6% (backtest 6 ปี, ค่า API ~$4/เดือน)
author: hai2usakiz
selftext:
Been building this for several months, sharing the architecture in case it's useful to others working on similar systems.



Key features:



\- Two-stage AI: Haiku for cheap news/market checks (hourly; full analysis 3x/day), Sonnet for actual trade decisions



\- 10-indicator signal scoring: RSI, MACD, EMA 9/21/50, Bollinger, MA200 (weighted 2x), ATR, Volume



\- Lesson engine: every stop-loss hit -> AI analyzes the pattern -> stored -> checked before next entry on same coin



\- Risk management: portfolio stop (15% DD), daily loss guard (5%), SL cooldown (16h), dynamic trailing stop, BTC-wide regime gate, time-based exit (force-close stale positions after 35 bars / \~5.8 days)



Backtest (6yr, 2020-2025, 6 pairs, 4H, fee 0.1% + slippage 0.1%):



\- 684 trades

\- Max DD: -14.6% (vs Bitcoin's \~-78% peak-to-trough in 2022)

\- ROI: +166.27% total (DCA $10k/year) | XIRR +30.47%/yr — heavily inflated by the 2021 supercycle (+238% that year), so I lead with the normalized figure instead

\- Normalized CAGR (excl. 2021): +18.87%/yr — 2022 (the bear, BTC \~-65%) still finished +15.93%

\- Win rate: 47.4% (below 50% — the edge is in cutting losers small, not hit rate)

\- Weak spot, disclosed: choppy 2026 YTD is -1.97%



The MA200 + BTC-regime gate are what keep it out of bear markets. Happy to go deeper on any part of the architecture — ask away.
